newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota surplus to reach $2.3 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota surplus to reach $2.3 bln - paper.

text.p: Minnesota's projected budget surplus is now expected to reach $2.3 billion, the Star Tribune reported Thursday.
The projected surplus is up $900 million from the previous estimate of $1.4 billion for the end of the upcoming fiscal 1998-99 bienium, the newspaper said.
Gov. Arne Carlson is scheduled to release the new surplus number Thursday afternoon in St. Paul. The newspaper said the Republican governor will also propose a $1 billion tax cut.
